list.title: creators/createContentDirectory.js
list.description:
Content directory initialization script for the ICJIA R3 Nuxt 3 application. This script prepares the content directory and cleans up generated files for a fresh build.

The script performs two main operations:

  1. Empties the content directory to remove any existing generated content
  2. Removes specified generated files from public, assets, and src directories

This is typically run at the beginning of the build process to ensure a clean state.

list.title: creators/createSiteRoutes.js
list.description:
Site routes aggregator script for the ICJIA R3 Nuxt 3 application. This script combines all route definitions from different content types into a single unified routes file for application navigation and routing purposes.

The script merges routes from pages, news, FAQs, resources, and manual content, removes duplicates, and outputs the consolidated routes to both public and assets directories.
